# `state/facts/Fact.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/facts/Fact.js`

state/facts/Fact.js — canonical facts + tombstones.  Layer law: facts are MONOTONIC. We prefer adding facts, never deleting them. "Deletion" is a tombstone fact `revoked(<fact>)`; projection later decides what is currently valid. A fact is just a canonical string predicate so that {A,B} and {B,A} hash identically (see util/hashing.canonicalSetHash).

## Functions

### `fact(predicate, ...args)`

Build a canonical fact string: fact('hasKey','player','red') → "hasKey(player,red)".

### `revoke(f)`

Wrap a fact as a tombstone (the monotonic stand-in for deletion).

### `isTombstone(f)`

Is this fact a tombstone?

### `tombstoneTarget(f)`

The fact a tombstone revokes, or null.
